WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,
           REPLACE(CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code))), 'RI', 'RD')  AS id_debt_model_portfolio,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           UPPER(reporting_currency_il)                               AS reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           CASE il_investment_structure_level_2
               WHEN 'Real Estate Investments' THEN 'Real Estate'
               ELSE il_investment_structure_level_2
           END                                                        AS il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT id_model_portfolio,
           max(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY id_model_portfolio
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.id_model_portfolio,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.id_model_portfolio = mpc.id_model_portfolio
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity,
           df2.asset_carrying_value,
           df2.debt_carrying_value,
           df2.equity_carrying_value,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = ild.id_model_portfolio
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency = ild.reporting_currency_il
                                                     AND fx.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
),

yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

latest_investran_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) business_date
      FROM alternative_assets.investran_real_asset_deals
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

investran_deals AS (
    SELECT abor_security_id,
           model_portfolio_id,
           reporting_name,
           investran_deal_name,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           active_or_liquidated,
           investment_structure_1_source,
           investment_structure_2_source,
           investment_structure_3_source,
           family,
           pi_taxonomy,
           primary_investment_category,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(equity_ownership_percentage, '\d+(\.\d+)?') AS equity_ownership_percentage,
           industry_focus,
           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging
               WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
               ELSE developed_or_emerging
           END                                                        AS developed_or_emerging,
           country_of_exposure,
           deal_local_currency,
           deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           cost_base_cur,
           carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
           total_exposure_base_cur,
           items_affecting_unfunded_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_permanent_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_recallable_base_itd
      FROM alternative_assets.investran_real_asset_deals            d
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = d.model_portfolio_id
     WHERE d.business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM latest_investran_business_date)
),
listed_re_mp AS (
    SELECT distinct ref.model_portfolio_id,
        ref.model_portfolio_name,
        int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
        CASE
            regional_classification_name
            WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
            ELSE 'Developed'
        END AS developed_or_emerging
    FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten perf
        INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio ref ON perf.model_portfolio = ref.model_portfolio_id
    WHERE perf.model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 = 'Listed Real Estate' 
        AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(ref.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,
	        mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_re_mp

     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
lre_trans AS(
       SELECT 
            tr.created_date,
            tr.elementary_transaction_code,
            tr.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
            tr.counterparty_id,
            tr.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
            tr.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            tr.current_value_quotation_currency,
            tr.nominal,
            tr.payment_date,
            tr.period_closure_agreement_date,
            tr.period_closure_date,
            tr.period_closure_payment_date,
            tr.price,
            tr.quotation_currency,
            tr.abor_security_id
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
        INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp 
            ON tr.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id 
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 
                abor_transaction_number, 
                MAX(business_date) AS latest_business_date

            WHERE CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
            AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            GROUP BY abor_transaction_number
        ) subquery 
            ON tr.abor_transaction_number = subquery.abor_transaction_number 
            AND tr.business_date = subquery.latest_business_date
        WHERE 
            transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
    ),
lre_trans_sum AS(

        quotation_currency_code
    FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holdings

        FULL JOIN lre_trans_sum ON holdings.abor_security_id = lre_trans_sum.abor_security_id
        LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
           ON holdings.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
            AND CAST(holdingS.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
    WHERE 
        CAST(holdings.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4 NOT LIKE '%Discontinued%'

lre_deals AS (
    SELECT holdings.*,

        --     WHEN 'EMERGING' THEN 'Emerging'
        --     ELSE 'Developed'
        -- END AS developed_or_emerging

    WHERE CAST(sec.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)      
),

ra_deals AS (
    SELECT  (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS reporting_period,
    abor_security_id AS investment_code,
    abor_security_name AS legal_entity_name,
    abor_security_name AS investment_name,
    abor_security_name AS reporting_name,
    abor_security_name AS allocation_name,
    abor_security_name AS model_portfolio_name,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))  AS cppib_ownership_percentage,

    cppib_sector_classification_name_3 AS sector,
    cppib_sector_classification_name_4 AS sub_sector,
    'Real Assets' AS business_group,
    'Real Estate' AS business_sub_group,
    'Listed Real Estate' AS business_unit,
    quotation_currency_code AS investment_reporting_currency,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS investment_count,
    developed_or_emerging AS developed_emerging_country,
    int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name AS investment_manager,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS allocations_current,
	CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS commitments_current,

WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,

           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,

           il_governance_structure_level_2,

           UPPER(reporting_currency_il)                               AS reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           CASE il_investment_structure_level_2
               WHEN 'Real Estate Investments' THEN 'Real Estate'
               ELSE il_investment_structure_level_2
           END                                                        AS il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT id_model_portfolio,
           max(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY id_model_portfolio
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.id_model_portfolio,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.id_model_portfolio = mpc.id_model_portfolio
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity,
           df2.asset_carrying_value,
           df2.debt_carrying_value,
           df2.equity_carrying_value,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = ild.id_model_portfolio
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency = ild.reporting_currency_il
                                                     AND fx.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
),

yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

latest_investran_business_date AS (

     WHERE business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

investran_deals AS (

           reporting_name,

           family,

           primary_investment_category,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(equity_ownership_percentage, '\d+(\.\d+)?') AS equity_ownership_percentage,
           industry_focus,
           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging

               ELSE developed_or_emerging
           END                                                        AS developed_or_emerging,
           country_of_exposure,
           deal_local_currency,
           deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           cost_base_cur,
           carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,

 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = d.model_portfolio_id
     WHERE d.business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM latest_investran_business_date)

listed_re_mp AS (

        AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (

listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif

lre_trans AS(

            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,

            tr.counterparty_id,

            tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,

        WHERE

            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)

        LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent

            AND CAST(holdingS.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date

lre_deals AS (

ra_deals AS (
    SELECT  (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS reporting_period,

WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,
           REPLACE(CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code))), 'RI', 'RD')  AS id_debt_model_portfolio,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           UPPER(reporting_currency_il)                               AS reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           CASE il_investment_structure_level_2
               WHEN 'Real Estate Investments' THEN 'Real Estate'
               ELSE il_investment_structure_level_2
           END                                                        AS il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT id_model_portfolio,
           max(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY id_model_portfolio
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.id_model_portfolio,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.id_model_portfolio = mpc.id_model_portfolio
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity,
           df2.asset_carrying_value,
           df2.debt_carrying_value,
           df2.equity_carrying_value,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = ild.id_model_portfolio
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency = ild.reporting_currency_il
                                                     AND fx.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
),

yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

latest_investran_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) business_date
      FROM alternative_assets.investran_real_asset_deals
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

investran_deals AS (
    SELECT abor_security_id,
           model_portfolio_id,
           reporting_name,
           investran_deal_name,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           active_or_liquidated,
           investment_structure_1_source,
           investment_structure_2_source,
           investment_structure_3_source,
           family,
           pi_taxonomy,
           primary_investment_category,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(equity_ownership_percentage, '\d+(\.\d+)?') AS equity_ownership_percentage,
           industry_focus,
           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging
               WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
               ELSE developed_or_emerging
           END                                                        AS developed_or_emerging,
           country_of_exposure,
           deal_local_currency,
           deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           cost_base_cur,
           carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
           total_exposure_base_cur,
           items_affecting_unfunded_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_permanent_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_recallable_base_itd
      FROM alternative_assets.investran_real_asset_deals            d
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = d.model_portfolio_id
     WHERE d.business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM latest_investran_business_date)
),
listed_re_mp AS (
    SELECT distinct ref.model_portfolio_id,
        ref.model_portfolio_name,
        int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
        CASE
            regional_classification_name
            WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
            ELSE 'Developed'
        END AS developed_or_emerging
    FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten perf
        INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio ref ON perf.model_portfolio = ref.model_portfolio_id
    WHERE perf.model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 = 'Listed Real Estate' 
        AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(ref.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,
	        mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_re_mp
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
lre_trans AS(
       SELECT 
            tr.created_date,
            tr.elementary_transaction_code,
            tr.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
            tr.counterparty_id,
            tr.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
            tr.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            tr.current_value_quotation_currency,
            tr.nominal,
            tr.payment_date,
            tr.period_closure_agreement_date,
            tr.period_closure_date,
            tr.period_closure_payment_date,
            tr.price,
            tr.quotation_currency,
            tr.abor_security_id
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
        INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp 
            ON tr.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id 
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 
                abor_transaction_number, 
                MAX(business_date) AS latest_business_date
            FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
            WHERE CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
            AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            GROUP BY abor_transaction_number
        ) subquery 
            ON tr.abor_transaction_number = subquery.abor_transaction_number 
            AND tr.business_date = subquery.latest_business_date
        WHERE 
            transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
    ),
lre_trans_sum AS(
    SELECT 
        abor_security_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code = 'Buy' THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS total_buy_pc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code = 'Sell' THEN current_value_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS total_sell_pc
    FROM 
        lre_trans
    GROUP BY 
        abor_security_id

latest_holdings AS (
    SELECT int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
        sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
        sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
        developed_or_emerging,
        holdings.abor_security_id,
        abor_security_name,
        model_portfolio_name,
        abor_country_of_exposure_name,
        balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
        dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
        exposure_portfolio_currency,
        lre_trans_sum.total_buy_pc AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
        lre_trans_sum.total_sell_pc AS permanent_roc_historical,
        quotation_currency_code

WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,
           REPLACE(CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code))), 'RI', 'RD')  AS id_debt_model_portfolio,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           UPPER(reporting_currency_il)                               AS reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           CASE il_investment_structure_level_2
               WHEN 'Real Estate Investments' THEN 'Real Estate'
               ELSE il_investment_structure_level_2
           END                                                        AS il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT id_model_portfolio,
           max(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY id_model_portfolio
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.id_model_portfolio,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.id_model_portfolio = mpc.id_model_portfolio
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity,
           df2.asset_carrying_value,
           df2.debt_carrying_value,
           df2.equity_carrying_value,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = ild.id_model_portfolio
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency = ild.reporting_currency_il
                                                     AND fx.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
),

yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

latest_investran_business_date AS (

     WHERE business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

investran_deals AS (

           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging

           country_of_exposure,

     WHERE d.business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM latest_investran_business_date)

listed_re_mp AS (

        int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,

        AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(ref.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,

            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif

listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (

            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets'

            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp

      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

              )

        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT *

     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_re_mp

     SELECT *

),
lre_trans AS(
       SELECT 
            tr.created_date,
            tr.elementary_transaction_code,
            tr.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
            tr.counterparty_id,
            tr.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
            tr.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            tr.current_value_quotation_currency,
            tr.nominal,
            tr.payment_date,
            tr.period_closure_agreement_date,
            tr.period_closure_date,
            tr.period_closure_payment_date,
            tr.price,
            tr.quotation_currency,
            tr.abor_security_id
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
        INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp 
            ON tr.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id 
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 
                abor_transaction_number, 
                MAX(business_date) AS latest_business_date
            FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
            WHERE CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

            AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            GROUP BY abor_transaction_number
        ) subquery 
            ON tr.abor_transaction_number = subquery.abor_transaction_number 
            AND tr.business_date = subquery.latest_business_date
        WHERE 
            transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)

WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,
           REPLACE(CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code))), 'RI', 'RD')  AS id_debt_model_portfolio,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
