    WHERE CAST(sec.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)      
),

ra_deals AS (
    SELECT  (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS reporting_period,
    abor_security_id AS investment_code,
    abor_security_name AS legal_entity_name,
    abor_security_name AS investment_name,
    abor_security_name AS reporting_name,
    abor_security_name AS allocation_name,
    abor_security_name AS model_portfolio_name,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))  AS cppib_ownership_percentage,

    cppib_sector_classification_name_3 AS sector,
    cppib_sector_classification_name_4 AS sub_sector,
    'Real Assets' AS business_group,
    'Real Estate' AS business_sub_group,
    'Listed Real Estate' AS business_unit,
    quotation_currency_code AS investment_reporting_currency,
    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS investment_count,
    developed_or_emerging AS developed_emerging_country,
    int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name AS investment_manager,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS allocations_current,
	CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2)) AS commitments_current,

WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,

           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,

           il_governance_structure_level_2,

           UPPER(reporting_currency_il)                               AS reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           CASE il_investment_structure_level_2
               WHEN 'Real Estate Investments' THEN 'Real Estate'
               ELSE il_investment_structure_level_2
           END                                                        AS il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT id_model_portfolio,
           max(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY id_model_portfolio
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.id_model_portfolio,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.id_model_portfolio = mpc.id_model_portfolio
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity,
           df2.asset_carrying_value,
           df2.debt_carrying_value,
           df2.equity_carrying_value,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = ild.id_model_portfolio
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency = ild.reporting_currency_il
                                                     AND fx.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
),

yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

latest_investran_business_date AS (

     WHERE business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

investran_deals AS (

           reporting_name,

           family,

           primary_investment_category,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(equity_ownership_percentage, '\d+(\.\d+)?') AS equity_ownership_percentage,
           industry_focus,
           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging

               ELSE developed_or_emerging
           END                                                        AS developed_or_emerging,
           country_of_exposure,
           deal_local_currency,
           deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           cost_base_cur,
           carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,

 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = d.model_portfolio_id
     WHERE d.business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM latest_investran_business_date)

listed_re_mp AS (

        AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)

listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (

listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (

       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif

lre_trans AS(

            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,

            tr.counterparty_id,

            tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,

        WHERE

            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)

        LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent

            AND CAST(holdingS.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date

lre_deals AS (

ra_deals AS (
    SELECT  (SELECT reporting_period FROM latest_fiscal_quarter) AS reporting_period,

WITH 

quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_yardi_business_date AS (
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(DATE_PARSE(business_date, '%Y%m%d')), '%Y%m%d') AS business_date,
           MAX(as_of_date)                                                 AS as_of_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT('F', 
	              SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
				  ' Q', 
				  CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR))                AS reporting_period
	  FROM (
            SELECT CASE
                       WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM as_of_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                       THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, as_of_date))
                       ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, as_of_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM latest_yardi_business_date
           )
),

latest_fx_rates  AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           UPPER(currency) AS currency,
           rate
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_fx 
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_ownership_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)    AS asset_code,
           MAX(ownership_date) AS ownership_date,
           MAX(business_date)  AS business_date
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),
     
latest_yardi_ownership AS (
    SELECT TRIM(yo.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           yo.cppib_ownership_perc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_ownership yo 
INNER JOIN latest_yardi_ownership_dates lyod ON TRIM(yo.asset_code) = lyod.asset_code 
       AND yo.ownership_date = lyod.ownership_date
       AND yo.business_date = lyod.business_date
),

latest_local_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,           
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_3
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_data_file AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)          AS asset_code,
           asset_carrying_value,
           debt_carrying_value,
           equity_carrying_value,
           unfunded_commitment_cad,
           geographic_focus,
           exposure,
           occupied_area,
           total_area,
           capital_additions
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_df_2
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_local_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)                        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           reversal_of_previously_invested,
           expenses_inside_commitment,
           temporary_roc
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit_a
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_cad_invested_equity AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code)        AS asset_code,
           gross_invested_equity,
           temporary_roc,
           permanent_roc,
           net_invested_equity
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_invequit
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates AS (
    SELECT TRIM(asset_code) AS asset_code,
           MAX(dt_date)     AS last_updated
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation
     WHERE dt_date IS NOT NULL
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
  GROUP BY asset_code
),

latest_allocations_and_commitments AS (
    SELECT TRIM(ca.asset_code)     AS asset_code,
           ca.dt_date              AS last_updated,
           ca.allocation,
           ca.current_allocation,
           ca.commitments,
           ca.current_commitment,
           CASE 
               WHEN ca.allocation != 0 
               THEN ca.allocation - ca.commitments
               ELSE 0
           END                     AS uncommitted_allocation
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_commitment_allocation ca
INNER JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitment_dates cad 
        ON cad.asset_code = TRIM(ca.asset_code)
       AND cad.last_updated = ca.dt_date
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date    = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),

latest_yardi_investment_level_details AS (
    SELECT as_of_date,
           TRIM(asset_code)                                           AS asset_code,
           investment_name,
           CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code)))                       AS id_model_portfolio,
           REPLACE(CONCAT('R', UPPER(TRIM(asset_code))), 'RI', 'RD')  AS id_debt_model_portfolio,
           investment_agg_il,
           investment_agg_dev_stab_il,
           allocation_name_il,
           programmatic_investment_il,
           al_investment_name,
           il_governance_structure_level_1,
           il_governance_structure_level_2,
           investment_stage_current_il,
           country_exposure_il,
           currency_exposure_il,
           UPPER(reporting_currency_il)                               AS reporting_currency_il,
           sector_focus_level_1_il,
           sector_focus_level_2_il,
           funding_bucket_il,
           il_investment_structure_level_1,
           CASE il_investment_structure_level_2
               WHEN 'Real Estate Investments' THEN 'Real Estate'
               ELSE il_investment_structure_level_2
           END                                                        AS il_investment_structure_level_2,
           il_investment_structure_level_3,
           cppib_close_date,
           first_funding_date,
           disposition_date,
           windup_date,
           investment_count,
           emerging_market_il, 
           investment_manager_il
      FROM df_yardi_prod.yardi_assets
     WHERE i_level = 'IL'
       AND business_date = (SELECT bd.business_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
       AND as_of_date = (SELECT bd.as_of_date FROM latest_yardi_business_date bd)
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates AS (
    SELECT id_model_portfolio,
           max(business_date)  AS last_updated
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios
     WHERE investment_department_name = 'Real Assets'
  GROUP BY id_model_portfolio
),
latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes AS (
    SELECT mpc.id_model_portfolio,
           model_portfolio_name,
           mpc.business_date
      FROM holdings.scd_model_portfolios mpc
INNER JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_code_dates mpcd
        ON mpcd.id_model_portfolio = mpc.id_model_portfolio
       AND mpcd.last_updated = mpc.business_date
),
yardi_deals AS (
    SELECT ild.asset_code,
           ild.investment_name,
           ild.investment_agg_il,
           ild.allocation_name_il,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           own.cppib_ownership_perc,
           ild.il_governance_structure_level_1,
           ild.investment_stage_current_il,
           df2.geographic_focus,
           ild.sector_focus_level_1_il,
           ild.sector_focus_level_2_il,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_1,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_2,
           ild.il_investment_structure_level_3,
           ild.reporting_currency_il,
           ild.investment_count,
           ild.emerging_market_il,
           ild.investment_manager_il,
           ac.allocation * fx.rate                            AS allocations_current,
           ac.commitments * fx.rate                           AS commitments_current,
           ac.uncommitted_allocation * fx.rate                AS uncommitted_allocation_current,
           lie.gross_invested_equity * fx.rate                AS gross_invested_equity_current,
           lie.expenses_inside_commitment * fx.rate           AS expenses_inside_commitment_current,
           df3.capital_additions * fx.rate                    AS capital_additions_current,
           lie.temporary_roc * fx.rate                        AS temporary_roc_current,
           lie.reversal_of_previously_invested * fx.rate      AS reversal_of_previously_invested_current,
           df2.unfunded_commitment_cad                        AS unfunded_commitment_historical,
           ie.gross_invested_equity                           AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
           ie.temporary_roc                                   AS temporary_roc_cad,
           ie.permanent_roc                                   AS permanent_roc_cad,
           ie.net_invested_equity,
           df2.asset_carrying_value,
           df2.debt_carrying_value,
           df2.equity_carrying_value,
           df2.occupied_area,
           df2.total_area
      FROM latest_yardi_investment_level_details ild
 LEFT JOIN latest_yardi_ownership                own  ON own.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_data_file                  df2  ON df2.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_data_file                df3  ON df3.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_cad_invested_equity            ie   ON ie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_local_invested_equity          lie  ON lie.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_allocations_and_commitments    ac   ON ac.asset_code = ild.asset_code
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc  ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = ild.id_model_portfolio
 LEFT JOIN latest_fx_rates                       fx   ON fx.currency = ild.reporting_currency_il
                                                     AND fx.as_of_date = ild.as_of_date
),

yardi_deals_with_derived_fields AS (
    SELECT *,
           (
              equity_carrying_value
            + unfunded_commitment_current
           )                                                             AS equity_exposure
      FROM (SELECT *,
                   (
                      commitments_current
                    - invested_commitment_current
                   )                                                     AS unfunded_commitment_current 
              FROM (SELECT *,
                         (
                                gross_invested_equity_current 
                              + expenses_inside_commitment_current
                              - capital_additions_current
                              + temporary_roc_current 
                              + reversal_of_previously_invested_current
                         )                                               AS invested_commitment_current
                    FROM yardi_deals
              )
      )
),

latest_investran_business_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(business_date) business_date
      FROM alternative_assets.investran_real_asset_deals
     WHERE business_date = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),

investran_deals AS (
    SELECT abor_security_id,
           model_portfolio_id,
           reporting_name,
           investran_deal_name,
           mpc.model_portfolio_name,
           active_or_liquidated,
           investment_structure_1_source,
           investment_structure_2_source,
           investment_structure_3_source,
           family,
           pi_taxonomy,
           primary_investment_category,
           REGEXP_EXTRACT(equity_ownership_percentage, '\d+(\.\d+)?') AS equity_ownership_percentage,
           industry_focus,
           geographic_focus,
           CASE developed_or_emerging
               WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
               ELSE developed_or_emerging
           END                                                        AS developed_or_emerging,
           country_of_exposure,
           deal_local_currency,
           deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           unfunded_commitment_amt_base_cur,
           cost_base_cur,
           carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
           total_exposure_base_cur,
           items_affecting_unfunded_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_permanent_base_itd,
           return_of_capital_recallable_base_itd
      FROM alternative_assets.investran_real_asset_deals            d
 LEFT JOIN latest_holdings_model_portfolio_codes mpc ON mpc.id_model_portfolio = d.model_portfolio_id
     WHERE d.business_date = (SELECT business_date FROM latest_investran_business_date)
),
listed_re_mp AS (
    SELECT distinct ref.model_portfolio_id,
        ref.model_portfolio_name,
        int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
        CASE
            regional_classification_name
            WHEN 'Emerging Markets' THEN 'Emerging'
            ELSE 'Developed'
        END AS developed_or_emerging
    FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten perf
        INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio ref ON perf.model_portfolio = ref.model_portfolio_id
    WHERE perf.model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
        AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 = 'Listed Real Estate' 
        AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(ref.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,
	        mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_re_mp
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
lre_trans AS(
       SELECT 
            tr.created_date,
            tr.elementary_transaction_code,
            tr.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
            tr.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
            tr.counterparty_id,
            tr.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            tr.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
            tr.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            tr.current_value_quotation_currency,
            tr.nominal,
            tr.payment_date,
            tr.period_closure_agreement_date,
            tr.period_closure_date,
            tr.period_closure_payment_date,
            tr.price,
            tr.quotation_currency,
            tr.abor_security_id
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
        INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp 
            ON tr.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id 
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT 
                abor_transaction_number, 
                MAX(business_date) AS latest_business_date
            FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
            WHERE CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
            AND transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            GROUP BY abor_transaction_number
        ) subquery 
            ON tr.abor_transaction_number = subquery.abor_transaction_number 
            AND tr.business_date = subquery.latest_business_date
        WHERE 
            transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
            AND business_transaction_code != 'BalBook'
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
            AND CAST(tr.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
    ),
lre_trans_sum AS(
    SELECT 
        abor_security_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code = 'Buy' THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS total_buy_pc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code = 'Sell' THEN current_value_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS total_sell_pc
    FROM 
        lre_trans
    GROUP BY 
        abor_security_id

latest_holdings AS (
    SELECT int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
        sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
        sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
        developed_or_emerging,
        holdings.abor_security_id,
        abor_security_name,
        model_portfolio_name,
        abor_country_of_exposure_name,
        balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
        dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
        exposure_portfolio_currency,
        lre_trans_sum.total_buy_pc AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
        lre_trans_sum.total_sell_pc AS permanent_roc_historical,
        quotation_currency_code

			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (

		array[

			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'

--CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW real_assets_portfolio_listed AS
WITH 
quarter_end AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter',  CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' DAY AS quarter_end_date
),
quarter_start AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3' MONTH AS quarter_start_date
),
latest_fiscal_quarter AS (
    SELECT CONCAT(
             'F', 
             SUBSTR(CAST(YEAR(reporting_date) as VARCHAR), 3, 2), 
             ' Q', 
             CAST(QUARTER(reporting_date) as VARCHAR)
           ) AS reporting_period
      FROM (
            SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM quarter_end_date) BETWEEN 4 AND 12 
                        THEN DATE_ADD('month', -3, DATE_ADD('year', 1, quarter_end_date))
                        ELSE DATE_ADD('month', 9, quarter_end_date)
                   END AS reporting_date
              FROM quarter_end
           )
),
listed_real_estate_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Real Estate'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4          = 'Listed Real Estate'
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name        NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3          = 'Infrastructure'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4         IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5         IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.model_portfolio_id,
            mp.model_portfolio_name,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            CASE mp.regional_classification_name
                 WHEN 'Emerging Markets' 
                 THEN 'Emerging'
                 ELSE 'Developed'
            END                                           AS developed_or_emerging
       FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten pif
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
         ON pif.model_portfolio                    = mp.model_portfolio_id
      WHERE pif.model_portfolio_name      NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
        AND pif.InvestmentStructure                = 'CPPIB_F24'    
        AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel2          = 'Real Assets'
        AND (
              (     pif.InvestmentStructureLevel3     = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel4     IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel5     IN ('Power Generation')
                AND pif.investmentstructurelevel6     IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                AND pif.InvestmentStructureLevel7     IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                AND pif.model_portfolio           NOT IN ('')
              )
              OR pif.model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
        )
        AND CAST(pif.business_date AS DATE)        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
),
listed_real_assets_model_portfolios AS (
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_infrastrucure_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_real_estate_model_portfolios
  UNION ALL
     SELECT * 
       FROM listed_sustainable_energies_model_portfolios
),
latest_abor_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.abor_transaction_number,
            MAX(t.business_date)       AS business_date
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag  = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code     != 'BalBook' -- come back to this
   GROUP BY t.abor_transaction_number
),
latest_transactions AS (
     SELECT t.elementary_transaction_code,
            t.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
            t.current_value_portfolio_currency,
            t.period_closure_date,
            t.abor_security_id
       FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON t.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
 INNER JOIN latest_abor_transactions lat
         ON t.abor_transaction_number = lat.abor_transaction_number
        AND t.business_date           = lat.business_date
      WHERE t.transaction_cancellation_flag     = 'Active'
        AND t.business_transaction_code        != 'BalBook'
        AND CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) <= (SELECT quarter_end_date FROM quarter_end)
        AND CAST(t.period_closure_date AS DATE) >= (SELECT quarter_start_date FROM quarter_start)
),
latest_total_buys_and_sells AS(
     SELECT abor_security_id,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CABuy', 'BuyInternal', 'Buy') 
                   THEN payment_amount_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad,
            SUM(
              CASE WHEN elementary_transaction_code IN ('CASell', 'SellInternal', 'Sell')
                   THEN current_value_portfolio_currency 
                   ELSE 0 
              END
            ) AS total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad
       FROM latest_transactions

latest_holdings AS (
     SELECT CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)               AS business_date,
            mp.int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
            asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
            s.country_of_exposure_name,

            h.abor_security_id,

            h.abor_country_of_exposure_name,
            h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
            h.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,

            tbs.total_buy_portfolio_currency_cad        AS gross_invested_equity_historical,
            tbs.total_sell_portfolio_currency_cad       AS permanent_roc_historical,
            h.quotation_currency_code
       FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 INNER JOIN listed_real_assets_model_portfolios mp
         ON h.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(mp.business_date AS DATE)
 INNER JOIN reference.scd_securities s
         ON h.abor_security_id                                   = s.abor_security_id
        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(s.business_date AS DATE)

        AND CAST(h.business_date AS DATE)                        = CAST(asec.business_date AS DATE)
      WHERE asec.cppib_sector_classification_name_4       NOT LIKE '%Discontinued%'

ra_deals AS (

            developed_or_emerging                                         AS developed_emerging_country,
            int_ext_managed_and_managed_accounts_name                     AS investment_manager,
            CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(32, 2))                                  AS allocation,

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 04 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 05 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 23:33:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'

		, value
	from (

			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	select * from scd_perf

	select * from perf

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 05
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-05 22:08:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    group by limit_name,

        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'
        and limit_id not in (
            select limit_id
            from old_breached_records
        )
    group by limit_name,
        limit_id
),
first_breach_date as (
    select *
    from old_breached_records
    union all
    select *

    union all

FROM (with lt_base as (
	select
		  mhl.business_date
		, date_add( 'month', 9, mhl.business_date ) as fiscal_date
		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified like '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1

				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization

					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
			  'MIN1000042'
			, 'NPTESTA'
			, 'NPTESTB'
			, 'PMIEMELTCS'
			, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
			, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
			, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
		) 
		and mhl.business_date >= cast( '2019-03-31' as date ) -- only pull from F20 onwards because unitization data only goes back to 2018-10-01
), lt_final as (
	select
		  lt_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case 
			when business_date = ( max( business_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from business_date ), extract( month from business_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_month_end
		, case 
			when fiscal_date = ( max( fiscal_date ) over ( partition by extract( year from fiscal_date ) ) ) then 'Y'
			else 'N'
		  end is_fiscalyear_end
		, case 
			when external_reporting_country in ( 'CHINA', 'HONG KONG', 'TAIWAN', 'MACAO' ) then 'Greater China'
			when external_reporting_country = 'INDIA' then 'India'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'United States', 'Canada' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' and external_reporting_region = 'Europe' then 'DM Europe'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'DM' then 'Other DM'
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' and external_reporting_region in ( 'Latin America' ) then external_reporting_region
			when external_reporting_dm_em = 'EM' then 'Other EM'
		  end external_reporting_dm_em_region
		, case -- temporary logic to coalesce currency of exposure code and parent quoted currency until fix is implemented in LT product
			when coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code ) in ( 'USD', 'CAD', 'EUR', 'CNY', 'JPY', 'INR', 'BRL' ) then coalesce( currency_of_exposure_code, parent_quoted_currency_code )
			else 'Other'
		  end external_reporting_currency
	from
		lt_base
), lt_final_agg as (
	select *
	from (
		select
			  lt_agg.business_date
			--, lt_agg.fiscal_date
			, lt_agg.pool_name
			, lt_agg_unpivot.account_name
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_01
			, lt_agg.investment_structure_level_02
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_country
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_assetmix
			, lt_agg.business_date_string
			, lt_agg.year_month
			, lt_agg.is_month_end
			, lt_agg.is_fiscalyear_end
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_dm_em_region
			, lt_agg.external_reporting_currency
			--, lt_agg.total_market_value_pc as total_market_value_pc_orig
			, lt_agg_unpivot.total_market_value_pc
		from (
			select
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
				, sum( total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
				, sum( bcpp_total_market_value_pc ) as bcpp_total_market_value_pc
				, sum( acpp_total_market_value_pc ) as acpp_total_market_value_pc
			from
				lt_final
			group by 
				  business_date
				--, fiscal_date
				, pool_name
				, investment_structure_level_01
				, investment_structure_level_02
				, external_reporting_dm_em
				, external_reporting_region
				, external_reporting_country
				, external_reporting_assetmix
				, business_date_string
				, year_month
				, is_month_end
				, is_fiscalyear_end
				, external_reporting_dm_em_region
				, external_reporting_currency
		) lt_agg
		cross join unnest( -- UNVPIVOT ACCOUNTS
			array [ 'bCPP', 'aCPP' ],
			array [ bcpp_total_market_value_pc, acpp_total_market_value_pc ]
		) lt_agg_unpivot ( account_name, total_market_value_pc )
	)
	where total_market_value_pc is not null and total_market_value_pc != 0
)
select * from lt_final_agg) AS "finsights_holdings_lookthrough"

		logs_with_concat_data

		date_trunc('minute', datetime)

		COUNT(*) >= 500

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

	SELECT *,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
			PARTITION BY abor_security_id
			ORDER BY business_date DESC
		) AS rn
	FROM reference.scd_securities
	WHERE business_date = '2025-06-04'

SELECT a.*,
	b.*,
	c.*,
	d.*,
	e.*,
	f.*,
	g.*
From (
		select h.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
			h.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
			h.security_group_name as security_group_name,
			h.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
			h.abor_security_sub_asset_class_code_name as investment_department_name,
			par.id_cppib_party as id_counterparty,
			h.abor_security_name as security_name,
			h.abor_security_number as security_no,
			h.cppib_sec_id as cppib_sec_id,
			null as id_enterprise_holding,
			par.party_name as issuer_name,
			sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
			sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
			sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
			sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
			sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
			h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
			h.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
			h.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
			h.clean_value_portfolio_currency / 1000 as clean_price_pc,
			h.clean_price as clean_price_qc,
			h.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
			h.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc,
			h.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,
			h.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal,
			h.fx_factor_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency * h.balance_nominal_number as current_nominal_pc,
			null as instrument_type_code,
			h.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,
			sec.abor_issue_currency as currency,
			h.security_group_id as security_group_code,
			h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
			h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
			h.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code
		from RankedSecurities sec
			left join reference.scd_party_issuer par on sec.abor_issuer_id = par.party_id
			and sec.business_date = par.business_date
			join holdings.scd_holdings_main h on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
		where sec.rn = 1
			and h.business_date = '2025-06-04'
			and (
				(
					h.security_group_id = 'PEDIRECT'
					and h.abor_security_type_id = 'PEDIRECT'
				)
				OR (
					h.security_group_id = 'PESECOND'

				OR (

						'LARGEBO',
						'LEGACY',

						'MIDMKTBO',

  (select

/* cppi::c6c5dc9988dcaae153ab1e6f0c2115c187e89f9f1e3267de977cb8a96dd3d2a8 */
/* QuickSight 6a03d450-9b93-4460-8c09-635326222a12 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date

FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)

	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"
